purpose: Variable map for the personalized edition. Every order supplies these fields; build.js fills them into WORDS.md and the art. Code source of truth: personalize.js (limits, looks, pronouns, checks). Keep this file and personalize.js in step.

child_name.allowed: Latin letters incl. accents (A–Z, À–ɏ), spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, periods. Other scripts and emoji go to the review queue (the fonts cannot print them).
child_name.casing: Kept as typed (McKenzie, DeShawn). ALL CAPS or all lower-case is converted to Title Case.
printed_on: 6 rhymes: s1 right, s2 left, s5 right, s9 right, s11 right, s12 right
family reading pledge (intro, a promise, the child's mark line)
How to use page (note + '<name>'s favorite laps')
hardcover spine (when the spine is 0.25 in or wider)

giver_name.if_empty: the With love from line is left out
giver_name.store_label: Who is it from? (e.g. Aunt Lily)

printed_on: pledge promise (so {{THEY}} can take a turn)
pronouns.rule: The rhymes never use a pronoun, so verbs always agree and the meter never changes. After {{THEY}} use only can/will/did or past tense.

printed_on: s10 right (We drape it from {{GRANDMA}}’s wheelchair)
grandma_name.rule: A fixed list, never free text: each option scans in the same rhymes. Matching ignores capitals. Anything not on the list, or the same as the child’s name, is held for the weekly review.
grandma_name.changes: words only; the drawing of Grandma is the same in every copy
grandma_name.store_label: What does your child call Grandma? (optional)

1.desc: Brown skin, black hair in two puffs

4.desc: Deep brown skin, black hair in a bun

look.changes: the story's child on every page, the cover and the dedication (skin and hair only; clothes and the family cast stay the same)

format.changes: which cover-wrap file and printer product is used; the interior is identical

gift_message.if_empty: the founder's default dedication from WORDS.md (## default dedication) is printed

gift_date.store_label: Occasion or date (optional, e.g. Baby shower, May 2027)

channel.changes: etsy builds the Etsy edition: no playbeforepixels.com URL and no QR code on the copyright page, last page or back cover (BRAND.md customer-voice rule 2). The last page instead says more books are in the same shop.
channel.store_label: (set by the order job, not the buyer)

derived_variables.{{FRIEND}}: The park friend in spread 7. "Ada"; becomes "Nell" when the child is named Ada, so a child never meets a friend with their own name.

fit_rules: Every line holding a variable shrinks to fit (story lines down to 19.5 pt from 27 pt; dedication name down to 22.5 pt). render-order.js stops the order (exit 5) if anything still does not fit, and a person looks at it in the weekly check.
review_queue_triggers: characters the fonts cannot print (non-Latin scripts, emoji)
giver, message or date over the limit
review wording list in personalize.js (profanity and a few sensitive words)
grandma_name not on the list, or the same as the child’s name
human_authorship_gate: build.js --order refuses to build while any WORDS.md heading still ends in (draft) or ## author note is empty. The founder rewrites or approves each section in her own words, then removes (draft).
privacy: Child names are used only to print the order. They are not added to the email list or any marketing, not committed to git (orders/ is git-ignored except examples/), and order folders are deleted 30 days after delivery [VERIFY retention period with counsel].

sample_order.gift_message:
May every day bring you a lap, a story and a song.
We love you to the moon and back.

typesetting: Straight quotes and apostrophes in the name, giver, message and date are printed as curly ones (can't → can’t, "Hi" → “Hi”). A line never starts with an em dash.
